title: Building UI/UX Dataset for Dark Pattern Detection and YOLOv12x-based Real-Time Object Recognition Detection System
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection of 'dark patterns' (deceptive UI designs) using computer vision. While dark patterns are an ethical concern in user interface design, the paper's primary contribution is a visual dataset and an object detection system, not the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
